title: Line bundles of large degree are very ample
statement:
Let $C$ be a proper smooth connected curve of
genus $g$ ([def-sc-genus]) over an algebraically closed
field $k$, and $\mathcal M$ a line bundle on $C$ with
$\deg\mathcal M\geq2g+1$ ([def-sc-pic0]). Then
$\mathcal M$ is very ample.

proof.text: Write $d=\deg\mathcal M$. By [lem-sc-riemann-roch-large-degree], every line bundle $\mathcal N$ on $C$ of degree at least $2g-1$ has $\dim_k H^0(C,\mathcal N)=\deg\mathcal N+1-g$. For rational points $P,Q$ (possibly equal), [def-sc-pic0] gives $\deg\mathcal O_C(P)=1$ and additivity of degree, so $\mathcal M$, $\mathcal M(-P)$ and $\mathcal M(-P-Q)$ have degrees $d\ge2g+1$, $d-1\ge2g$ and $d-2\ge2g-1$. Therefore $\dim H^0(C,\mathcal M(-P))=\dim H^0(C,\mathcal M)-1$ and $\dim H^0(C,\mathcal M(-P-Q))=\dim H^0(C,\mathcal M)-2$.

source.place: ## Proof, first paragraph (degree and Riemann–Roch dimension drops)

proof.text: The first dimension drop means that, for every point $P$, a global section exists that does not vanish at $P$, so the complete linear system is base-point free. For distinct $P,Q$, the two-point drop gives a section vanishing at one and not the other, hence separates points; for $P=Q$, it gives a section whose vanishing order at $P$ is exactly one, hence separates tangent vectors. Thus the hypotheses of the separation criterion are satisfied.

source.place: ## Proof, second paragraph (base points, points, and tangent vectors)

proof.text: Applying [lem-sc-very-ample-separation-criterion] to the proper smooth connected curve $C$ and the line bundle $\mathcal M$ gives that $\mathcal M$ is very ample, which is the claimed conclusion.
